items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: Roy Haynes sits in on the record. That’s one of my favorites of all time.

ctx.x: I hear some Art Blakey in your music. I mean I hear that kind of that unbridled energy in some of the tunes and stuff, remember that Blue Note —

I love that period. I love the 50’s, I love the 60’s too. I love the Freddie Hubbard band and the Lee Morgan band. But yeah, I [inaudible]. I love Bird too. Bird and Fats was probably my favorite band if I had to pick one, it would be with Bird with Fats, “One Night at Birdland” with Bud Powell and Tommy Potter and I guess Art Blakey is on the record. Roy Haynes sits in on the record. That’s one of my favorites of all time. I love Fats Navarro. He is one of my first influences. But after that period of Clifford,…
In jazz improvising now, what constitutes a wrong note?
